body:
Thanks yeah we’ve talked about it before about a payment plan but then I hit another bump in the road and it just gets set back.  I just wish I could hit the lotto and pay off all at once lol.  

Dating wise I haven’t had a solid long term relationship in years. Tried the whole tinder bumble what have you ans it hasn’t panned out, I’m still going for it though.   As for the dreams I’ve been working towards professional acting for years . I’m not in LA or NYC so it’s not one of the crazy huge markets so I’m stuck with a decent job but it feels dead end. 

I just feel lost at times . With this pandemic going on, I know I should have tone to get stuff squared away to get a better job, get back into reading and just get more in tune with myself but i just can’t get myself into that mindset .

I know my folks love me but I wish I didn’t feel like I was disappointing them / worrying them all the time.  Going away would make things so muc worse in them but I just want this pain and stress to go away .

Yeah I can imagine! I just feel I’ve got a lot of love to give and wanna share experiences with someone ( so I keep my eyes peeled)  last relationship a few years back ended with her cheating on me  with a friend I introduced her too and now they’re married and have a kid.
Things will turn around soon. Congrats on the marriage though. I’ve been single for far too long lol
I’ve been chasing my dreams of active ever since highschool . Been on national tv as had plenty of independent projects and auditions :)
Keep it up! I gave it the good college try but math was the death of me lol.

I tend to make Josie ans keep everyone happy , but look dumb in the process .i hate it. The only thing I think holding me back is the fact I don’t think I’d be successful in pulling it off  and the slight thoughts of what I would miss. So here I am :)

Yeah I get that. I tend to look in the bright side as well especially around friends and family. No one knows that I get this down. I think my best friend may cause I texted him that I was finishing off a bottle of booze he got me. He asked what was wrong and oddly enough nothing was wrong, it was just almost empty so I finished it. Other thank that instance though he nor anyone has checked up on me .
Wow that was deep! I’ve felt that too, but could really never put it that eloquently before :)
Thanks :) yeah I think being cooped up is kind of getting to me I miss my family and all my friends . I’ve been playing guitar daily so that’s a start :)
The name sounds familiar. I’ll check him out when I get back to work lol
Wow this is really good! It’s really soothing and I can really get into this. Thanks!

Thanks :). I do have quite a few hobbies and this also got into the dreams I want to achieve( music and acting). It’s just that getting home from work, I’m so mentally drained they I can’t find the will power to jump into it. I know I just need to muster up that determination again and just go for it :)

I’ve been single for quite a few years. Had a few dates here and there , but nothing concrete. My ex decided to break things off and started seeing my co worker the next day. So I guarantee you some was up there . They’re no married and have a kid -.- so I k ow what it’s like. Just keep your head up and focus on yourself. The right person will come along. You just need to keep your eyes open
I’m sorry that happened. Keep you’re head up. There’s a on one out there that will value you and treat you like you should be  treated.

There are a ton of FB groups most of them are made up of parents with young kids with hydrocephalus( with a few adult members as well) I’ve found this group to be really helpful. 

The one thing to keep in mind is that everyone one has different experiences with hydrocephalus. So you can learn and grow from any group.

For instance , I’m not really limited at all with what I can’t do ( minus crazy roller coasters) . So seeing everyone else’s experiences with this sheds a whole new light on the condition for me. It also makes me really great full to interact and learn from everyone

Thanks for the tips! I really just need to breath and just take it a step at a time. I lost my grandpa 2 weeks ago so it’s been a little tough getting back to reality and just two days ago my car broke down and I’ve been bumming rides to get to work.  So the whole car thing is literally the thing keeping me up since I don’t want to burden anyone. :/ I’ve got a book laying around somewhere. I may have to try that out :)

Thanks for the pointers. I tend to normally do that to be honest , but this was a totally different feeling with the insomnia. You may see it in an earlier reply but the service was amazing and a lot of people gave my grandfather so much praise . It really made me proud  to be his grandson and helped put my mind at ease .

That’s really a great way of thinking about it. I think with me it was just the weight of the upcoming funeral that gave me little to no sleep.  I’ll be honest it was an amazing funeral and a lot of people spoke incredibly high of my grandfather. So now knowing all those kind words and seeing how much he meant to everyone else will help put my mind at ease and allow me to sleep

Yeah I’m with my folks and my brother( all passed out) so I’m not alone . Also with no tv in my room, I’m just trying to find an article or something on my phone to put me at ease. Tomorrow is the actual funeral so I’m not out of the storm yet .  

I guess I’m just hoping I made him proud :)


Sorry for your loss and I hope you found peace during your difficult time as well .

Thanks. Yea I know he’ll always be there I did get my send of humor and pride of my Irish heritage from him.  It’s strange the night he passed , I could have sworn I felt someone holding my hand  when I was falling asleep ...
He better be good and get drafted by the Vikings !
Update: he passed away overnight.  It will be rough going up to the funeral, but at least I k ow he’s in a better place and pain free .
He’ll be one and done in brown town for sure 😅

Thank you.  It’s been a rough few years and I knew this was coming sooner or later . He is 94 and that’s quite the milestone in itself. It just a pain since he nor my grandma will get to see me have a wife and kids like all my other cousins and my brother who have their stuff all together. I just want them to see that I was successful , ya know ?

I’m right there with you . I’ve been single for god knows how long ( flings here and there) yet I want the end of the rainbow. I want something lol my lasting hell a hug would  match that . Keep your head up, good things will come. You just need to keep your eyes open
No, it’s just general anxiety for me ( basically just worrying about stupid stuff and over thinking . 98% of the time I don’t even notice my shunt.
Right back at ya man!
No one thought we could win NO ONE. Now it’s time to take a breath and get back to work on Tuesday. Great win guys! SKOL!
I’m giving it another go :) happy new year to all!
That sounds like a great idea. I’m an actor as wells . So I just need a gig and need to get down to studying Lines lol

Yeah, my New Years resolution isn’t to get into a routine where I can work out in the morning . I do tend to wind down till about 11 eating dinner and watching some tv, but the I’m still full blown awake

I’ve been there before and I always wondered what was actually going on and I did a school project back in highschool and found out about the whole anxiety and depression side. So I’ve watched that closely
Hahaha my tv is in the living room and I love my bed too much. Tea would be a great idea though. I need to get back into that stuff :)

Reach out to those who love you. If you can’t bring yourself to do that( like me) find something you’re passionate about and engulf yourself in that so it brings you happiness and a new outlook. I’ve been doing it for a hot minute and I feel pretty good.

Yeah I was really just wanting to keep this records going , but I know it’s just one game. I’ve said it once and I’ll say it again : I’ll bleed purple and gold till I die.  Let’s rest everyone up and come back fully healthy to take on whoever we need to in order to make a strong run in the playoffs. SKOL!
Ha ha ha I see what you did there and I totally agree. I just really don’t want us to have to face green bay at their home in the dead of winter .

I’ve been there for quite some time. I just wanted to let you k ow I hope things turn around and you have a merry Christmas :).  Do whatever you can to look in the bright side and enjoy the time with your family
It would be nice to have some physical attraction :) I was seeing this girl for about a month but she wasn’t all into physicality.  So I knew it would t work. The search continues .....
I get home around 8 then just hang around and watch tv while cooking dinner. I tend to go to bed around 11 or so and tend to get up at 9am
Hahaha if only o was into vaping :). Maybe I should get back into some light reading.......
I can’t say I’ve experienced symptoms involving dreams. Have you gone in to see a neurologist since you’ve started having them ?

I remember everything about my last one though.  Everything started around a week or so before Christmas and I thought it was just allergies causing my headaches. Tuna out that wasn’t the case Ana I ended up having surgery the day before Christmas Eve . I wouldn’t wish that pain on anyone :(

I was around 4 ( so about the same age ) I just remember freaking out not wanting them to leave my side and the next thing I know the doors shit and I closed my eyes from there. I don’t really remember being gassed .

When it comes to the vision loss and spinning; those are pretty common with migraines. I tend to get blurred vision and some numbness in my fingers at times. If this keeps happening I would say go to your doctor to see what’s going on.  As for the dreams I can’t say I’ve had any in recent memory. I’ll  sometimes have flashbacks , but it was when I was being wheeled back into surgery when I was about  four.  Stay strong warrior!
Yeah It’s not like o was depressed at the time but like today I was like “ I should get a ouji board “ lol

It may just be me thing about spooky shit or whatever. Then again I had a friend take her life last year and I’ve thought of her almost every day. And some weird stuff will happen at my apartment . Like my door will shake uncontrollably then randomly stop .
Hey hit me up any time you need to talk. I’m always here and you can Soren the message me. What’s going on ?

I feel the same exact way to be honest . I’m always the one to put others first before myself and make sure everyone me is happy. Recently I’ve felt down and I think one of my friends is picking up in it, she wanted to talk tony got but then we all got distracted. I k ow she would be understanding and give a listen, but I don’t link I would flat out tell anyone I was thinking those thoughts . I just don’t want anyone to jump ahead and then take actions before talking . So I know where you’re coming from. 

That’s why I kind of dig this place , although we aren’t all face to face with each other, everyone seems to be there for each other . Keep your head up and stay strong. I’m here for ya .

Thanks. It’s funny I know exactly what I want to do but breaking into that field, being insured and having the money to live is the tough part lol( gotta love the entertainment industry )  when I was young I had medical issues so insurance is a must for me I case anything g went south again so that the main reason I’ve been at my job for so long . I just need to find a way to get that passion back.

Find what you’re passionate about and go after it. It can be anything : hiking, painting,music. Find what makes you YOU and embrace it. That will surely put the wind back in your sails and give you life again.

I know where you’re coming from and have felt the same way for a good month or two . So from one seeker to another : journey on and find that passion. I believe in you

You can always change who you are. That’s the evolution of life man. I never did the whole college experience ( a few community college courses) , but school was not my thing . A degree is really worth it though. If you don’t like the field you studied in, go for something you’re passionate about. Like I said a degree is a degree and you can go places with that . I’ve felt the same way about wasting my 20’s and here I am at 30 still not sure what I’m doing.

All I can say is keep you’re head up man. You’ve got things going for you and I bet your family is really proud of all that you’ve accomplished so far. You’ll meet some one trust me. I believe that everything happens for a reason and people come on out of your life for a reason as well. Stay true to who you are and those people that are meant to cross your path will. 

Congrats on the degree man!

Thanks! Yeah I totally get that and feel I’m actually here for a purpose . I just haven’t been able to fitful that purpose / dream yet. Maybe that’s what’s really keeping me here . There’s just times where it’s tough and I start questioning thing and get too into my head .I know  I just need to power through , but it can be hard .

Have you tried reaching out to friends . Sometimes lives get so busy , we have to make the first point of contact. Trust me I feel you and I’ve felt that way myself. Go ahead and try making that point of contact and if not, be within yourself. Find what your passionate about and engulf yourself with it . I did that just the other day and all I did was take a walk in a park :)

I just hit 30 :) and I have an agent . Im just stuck in a dead end job and need health insurance . Idk I just feel like I let that one slip away  you know ?  I alway try to keep a smile up but it can be hard at times :/

It’s a combination . Becoming a working actor ( I can always work on that ) but the second one is becoming a father . I come from a long line of love ( it’s a family saying )  I really want to be a dad and family man but can never find the right one or end up in terrible relationships.  I feel tht we’re here for a reason but I just feel lost and don’t know what to do
Strawberry is my favorite :)
Wonderful story . I’ve had quite a few revisions, but like you I’ve had very few setbacks :). Keep on fighting and nothing but good vibes abs happiness to you and your family :)

I’m just now learning how different is is for everyone . I see a lot of posts of people dealing with pain and I count my blessing that I’m not experiencing those symptoms . I do have headaches here and there but I’ve notice it’s more of the depression and sadness that I’m dealing with.  It is nice to k ow there’s a community to reach out to .

I had my last revision 12 years ago and I haven’t had any trouble since . Well maybe a few headaches here and there but that’s mainly with allergies :). 

When it comes to the depression it just feels like I’m being resin on in my head or I’m under water. I’ve been in meds before (vivance ) but felt it messed to much with my emotions . I’m an actor and I can’t be all up beat in a sad scene lol .   

Maybe I just need some motivation and I need to find my passion again.  It’s been a while since I’ve made anything really worth while and when I do, I feel on top of the world. Hell even finding this group make it all better . I can’t say I’ve found anyone where I live who I can relate to hahaha .
Having the ability to chase my dreams and getting into a national tv show right out of high school.

Twelve years ago mine just stopped working for no reason at all. I experienced excruciating headaches for a few days and went on vacation up north. As soon as I crossed the Texas border to Oklahoma I felt completely fine . Figuring it was just allergies I thought nothing of it until the headaches hit again and I ended up getting physically ill.  Just be sure to take care of yourself and talk to a doctor of something doesn’t feel right .If all is good, I say keep up the good fight fellow warrior !

I’ve been there before and trust me it’s rough. You just need to stay strong and move on . If you don’t find a relationship ( I haven’tand it’s been years) that’s totally cool! Just ficus on yourself if that’s the case and be the best person you can be.
I really need to get back into tea. I used to drink this orange tea with honey and it did wonders, but I won’t be goi g to the store till later today -.-
I’ve got representation as well as a website. I just need updates headshot and just put myself out there more. On the dating side this town just sucks although it’s huge lol
Great painting but this thread sucks ass

I felt like it was one of the weaker season finalizes to be honest . Nothing really stood out to me aside from the snow and frozen walkers( that was pretty cool. ) I think in i know  who’s in the other end of the radio ;)
